name: agentpress
description: AgentPress Model Context Protocol (MCP) manifest for headless WordPress RAG memory and autonomous agent workflows.

authentication.description: Provide a valid AgentPress API key generated in WP Admin -> AgentPress.

tools.name: read_wp_memory
tools.description: Fetches recent WordPress content or specific post IDs formatted in token-efficient Markdown with structured metadata (Author, Citations, Review Date) for RAG ingestion.

post_id.description: Optional specific WordPress Post ID to fetch.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

category.description: Optional category slug or ID filter.

tools.name: write_wp_draft
tools.description: Pushes generated Markdown content and structured metadata into a new or existing WordPress post draft.

id.description: Optional existing Post ID to update.

title.description: The title of the WordPress post.

content_markdown.description: Clean Markdown body content for the post.

meta.description: Structured metadata fields for AI provenance and citations.

citations.description: List of source URLs or citation references.
